India Post GDS 2nd Merit List 2026: Expected Release Date, Trends, and Download Process

Key takeawaysThe Indian Post Department is preparing to release the second merit list for the Gramin Dak Sevak (GDS) Online Engagement Schedule-II, July-2026 cycle. Following the conclusion of the initial document verification round, candidates who were not selected in the first lis

The Indian Post Department is preparing to release the second merit list for the Gramin Dak Sevak (GDS) Online Engagement Schedule-II, July-2026 cycle. Following the conclusion of the initial document verification round, candidates who were not selected in the first list are awaiting subsequent updates.

Expected Release Date and Timeline

Document verification for the GDS 1st merit list concludes on October 27, 2026. Based on historical trends from previous recruitment cycles, India Post typically requires a 15-day window following the completion of document verification to compile vacancy data from individual circles and release the subsequent merit list. Consequently, the GDS 2nd Merit List 2026 is anticipated around November 12, 2026.

For the ongoing recruitment drive, a total of 23,469 candidates were initially shortlisted against 23,757 vacancies for positions including Branch Postmaster (BPM), Assistant Branch Postmaster (ABPM), and Gramin Dak Sevak. The second list will address positions that remain unfilled after the initial document verification process concludes.

How to Access the Merit List PDF

When published, candidates can access the results through the official portal:

  • Visit the official India Post website at [indiapost.gov.in](https://www.jagranjosh.com/articles/india-post-gds-2nd-merit-list-2026-check-expected-date-based-on-previous-trends-1800018240-1).
  • Locate and select the 'Shortlisted Candidates: Schedule-II, July-2026' section on the menu bar.
  • Choose the specific state or postal circle corresponding to the application.
  • Download the regional Result PDF format.
  • Search for individual roll numbers or names within the document.

Selection Criteria and Process

Selections for GDS posts are conducted without written examinations or additional testing phases. Rankings are determined entirely by marks obtained in the Class 10th standard, calculated up to four decimal places. Higher educational qualifications do not factor into the evaluation. In the event of a tie where multiple candidates share identical Class 10 scores, preference is given based on date of birth, with older candidates prioritized.

Practical Implications and Verification

Applicants should monitor the official website regularly as release schedules are subject to administrative adjustments during the vacancy compilation phase. Readers can verify all updates directly via the [India Post Official Portal](https://www.jagranjosh.com/articles/india-post-gds-2nd-merit-list-2026-check-expected-date-based-on-previous-trends-1800018240-1).

  • Confirmed Facts: Document verification for the 1st merit list ends on October 27, 2026; 23,469 candidates were initially shortlisted for 23,757 vacancies.
  • Unknowns/Estimates: The exact release time and final count of vacant seats resulting from the first document verification round remain unconfirmed until officially published.
